scope: Retrieve movie descriptions, extract prompted Llama-3 representations with same-model title-only control, and audit observable historical Astra motivations. Do not re-open test selection.
description_source: mt0rm0/movie_descriptors, public TMDB-derived overview subset, exact pinned revision and content hashes recorded in coverage report
movie_matching: MovieLens metadata only; Unicode normalization, article and conjunction normalization, English/original-title aliases, unique title+year matches and unique +/-1-year fallback. No fuzzy match is autoaccepted. Missing or ambiguous descriptions remain explicitly missing.
encoder: Frozen base language model, not a purpose-trained embedding model; no generation or fine-tuning
title_only_control: Same instruction, title, readout suffix and model; omit Description line. Allows isolating added description from encoder replacement.
pooling: Last layer hidden state of the final valid input token; left padding; L2 normalization
missing_description_policy: Exact copy of corresponding same-model title-only vector, with availability mask and no generated plot
truncation: 512-token cap; truncate description content only; retain instruction/title/readout suffix
hardware_budget: one A100, one experiment <3600 seconds, external timeout and internal 3500-second watchdog
cost: Actual model version, prompt, token counts, full extraction and per-condition compute wall, peak GPU memory, hashes; no fabricated monetary conversion
quality_check: Finite normalized 1682x4096 arrays, exact fallback equality, deterministic top-neighbor diagnostics; not a recommendation performance evaluation
motivation_audit: Inspect saved hypotheses/diagnostics before first feedback versus proposals after feedback. Explicit rationale is not private internal reasoning. Interface examples and parent bias cues are confounders for claims of autonomous discovery.
next_recommendation_study: Freeze a new protocol before selection: same-model title-only vs title+description, availability-aware and same-item comparisons, fixed calibration and semantic smoothing controls, neutral editor prompt plus explicit pre-feedback hypotheses. Historical test results remain exploratory and cannot be treated as untouched test discovery.
